## 1. Executive Summary
Bishal Budhathoki is a Sydney-based Software Engineer specializing in full-lifecycle mobile application development, modern reactive web applications, scalable backend microservices, and cloud deployment pipelines. Holding a Master of Information Technology from CQUniversity, he combines formal software engineering principles with practical industry experience across Flutter, Kotlin, Android, iOS, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python/FastAPI, and Google Cloud Platform.

## 3. Technology Stack & Skill Inventory

### Mobile Development
- **Flutter & Dart**: State management (Bloc, Provider), custom UI component systems, REST/GraphQL integration, offline storage, responsive cross-platform layout (Android & iOS).
- **Kotlin & Android SDK**: Native Android lifecycle, Coroutines, Jetpack components, Retrofit, Material Design, Firebase SDK integration.
- **Cross-Platform Delivery**: Unified codebase delivery across web, Android, and iOS targets with native platform bridge integration.

### Web & Frontend Engineering
- **React.js & Next.js**: App Router, Server Components (RSC), SSR, SSG, incremental static regeneration, dynamic routing, performance optimization, streaming UI.
- **Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3/SCSS.
- **Styling & UI Systems**: Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, Radix UI primitives, Lucide icons, responsive design patterns, CSS-in-JS, dark mode ergonomics.
- **State Management & Data Fetching**: SWR, React Query, Context API.

### Backend, APIs & Microservices
- **Node.js & Express**: Event-driven services, JWT/session authentication, API rate-limiting, middleware architecture.
- **Python & FastAPI**: Async REST microservices, Pydantic data schemas, Google Sheets API dynamic ETL pipelines, GitHub GraphQL API proxying, in-memory TTL caching.
- **Java**: Core Java, object-oriented software design patterns, multithreading, algorithmic scheduling, desktop applications (Swing).
- **API Protocols**: RESTful architecture, GraphQL, JSON Schema validation, CORS policy configuration.

### Cloud, Databases & DevOps
- **Cloud Infrastructure**: Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Artifact Registry), Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Storage, Realtime Database, Cloud Messaging).
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase Firestore, relational database schema normalization, indexing.
- **Containers & DevOps**: Docker, containerized build pipelines, continuous integration & deployment (CI/CD) via GitHub Actions and Google Cloud Build triggers.
- **Version Control & Collaboration**: Git, GitHub, branching workflows, peer review, code quality tooling.

### Soft Skills & Professional Competencies

- Cross-functional communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Agile / Scrum sprint execution and sprint planning

## 4. Notable Software Engineering Projects

### 4.1 CareNest
- **Domain**: NDIS (National Disability Insurance Scheme) & Australian Disability Care Management
- **Description**: An integrated care management, shift logging, and invoicing platform built specifically for Australian NDIS disability support providers and independent support coordinators.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Worker shift scheduling and GPS-aware arrival verification.
  - Client progress note recording with privacy compliance.
  - Timesheet tracking with automatic overtime and weekend penalty calculation.
  - Single-click NDIS-compliant bulk invoice generation with line-item code mapping.
  - Role-based access control (Admin, Support Coordinator, Worker, Client).
- **Tech Stack**: Flutter, Dart, Node.js, Firebase Firestore, Google Cloud Run microservices.
- **Repository / Link**: https://bishalbudhathoki.com/projects

### 4.2 Hamro Ghar (Tenant-Web-App)
- **Domain**: Property & Rental Accommodation Management
- **Description**: Full-stack web application developed to simplify tenant agreements, room allocation, maintenance ticketing, and payment tracking for landlords and shared house occupants.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Tenant onboarding and lease duration tracking.
  - Rent ledger with automated receipt generation.
  - Maintenance request pipeline with image uploads and status progression.
- **Tech Stack**: React.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS.
- **Repository / Link**: https://bishalbudhathoki.com/projects

### 4.3 Invoice Generator
- **Domain**: Enterprise Billing & Accounting
- **Description**: Robust desktop accounting tool built in Java for generating, managing, and printing compliant commercial invoices.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Itemized pricing, dynamic tax computations, and currency formatting.
  - Clean vector PDF export using document generation libraries.
  - Local persistence for repeat client catalogs.
- **Tech Stack**: Java, Swing, PDF Generation Libraries.

### 4.4 Automated Timetable Generation System
- **Domain**: Higher Education & Algorithmic Scheduling
- **Description**: Research application developed to solve the NP-hard university course timetabling problem without classroom or instructor collisions.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Genetic algorithms and heuristic constraint satisfaction.
  - Multi-objective fitness function evaluating room capacity, instructor preferences, and student cohorts.
  - Published in a peer-reviewed international journal.
- **Tech Stack**: Java, Genetic Algorithms, Heuristic Optimization.

### 4.5 Don't Fall & Algorithmic Games
- **Domain**: Mobile & Interactive Game Engineering
- **Description**: Physics-based balance mobile game and algorithmic chess pathfinding utilities.
- **Capabilities**: Custom collision systems, state machines, and touch input normalization.
- **Tech Stack**: Unity, C#, Java, Android SDK.
